source_summaries.cdc_linkco15: This dataset provides detailed information on infant deaths and their causes, including SUID. It includes variables such as sex of the infant, gestational age at birth, maternal smoking status during pregnancy, preterm birth indicators, breastfeeding status, and geographic location. However, it lacks specific variables for experimental conditions like chronic intermittent hypoxia or neurogenesis.
